Class LuaScriptContainerBuilder

Namespace
Cobilas.GodotEngine.Lua
Assembly
com.cobilas.godot.lua.dll

Provides a builder pattern for constructing Lua script containers with fields, tables, and functions.

Remarks

This class simplifies the creation of Lua scripts by providing a fluent interface for adding various types of fields, tables, and functions to a script container.
